ios.desc:
Stop mindless scrolling. Take back your day. Meet Ember, your personal focus companion.

Most app blockers fail because they are cold, boring, or easy to switch off the moment an urge hits. Ember changes that by combining unbreakable Apple Screen Time blocking with a warm, gamified sanctuary you will actually love opening.

Whether you need to study for exams, enter deep work at the office, or disconnect before sleep, Ember shields your attention so you can be fully present.

HOW EMBER HELPS YOU WIN YOUR TIME BACK

• Instant App Blocking
Select the social media, games, or shopping apps that pull you away. Tap start and they vanish behind Ember’s shield instantly.

• Smart Automated Schedules
Set recurring focus blocks for mornings, work hours, or bedtime. Ember shields distractions automatically every single day without you lifting a finger.

• Unbreakable Locked Mode
When temptation strikes, Locked Mode requires a 15 minute countdown before you can pause your session. That short delay breaks the dopamine loop and keeps your willpower intact.

• Keep the Fire Lit
Every minute of focus feeds your campfire. Complete sessions to build daily streaks, kindle warm embers, and earn peaceful milestone badges.

• The Den Sanctuary
Level up your cozy mountain cabin as you focus. Unlock eight handcrafted decor upgrades including wool blankets, steaming herbal tea, antique journals, a stone hearth, and a shimmering starlit aurora.

• Soothing Cabin Atmospheres
Pair your focus sessions with calming ambient audio like crackling hearth embers, peaceful rain, and quiet nighttime soundscapes.

• Home and Lock Screen Widgets
Check your focus streak and daily progress at a glance without ever getting sucked into your phone. Add widgets to your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and Control Center.

• 100% Private and Secure
Your privacy comes first. Ember uses Apple Screen Time technology running entirely on device. We never track, inspect, or store your app usage or browsing history. Everything stays yours.

PERFECT FOR

• College students and professionals needing deep study sessions
• Anyone looking to break social media and doomscrolling addiction
• Remote workers seeking structured work boundaries
• Mindful individuals creating quiet evenings and better sleep hygiene

EMBER PRO

Upgrade to Ember Pro to unlock unlimited app blocking, unlimited schedules, strict Locked Mode, and all cozy soundscapes.
